audit_items.proof_trace: The Go code delegates to ckzg4844.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch without passing any domain separator parameter, creating complete dependency on the C library's hardcoded domain constant. No runtime verification exists to ensure the library uses RANDOM_CHALLENGE_KZG_CELL_BATCH_DOMAIN, enabling potential cross-protocol replay if the library has bugs or version mismatches.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker generates valid proofs for Deneb protocol (RCKZGBATCH___V1_) and replays them in Fulu context (expecting RCKZGCBATCH__V1_). If c-kzg-4844 library doesn't enforce domain separation correctly or has build/version mismatches, proofs validate in wrong protocol context, bypassing safety invariants.
